name: git-paoding
description: Teach Codex to partition a canonical change into semantic Draft PR review projections.

interface.shortDescription: Create semantic review projections from one canonical change.
interface.longDescription: Guide Codex through git-paoding's inspect, assign, publish, refresh, and archive workflow while keeping one authoritative integration branch.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use git-paoding to prepare semantic Draft PR review projections for the committed change on my current branch. Inspect first and do not publish until I authorize remote changes.
